items.title: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: 2026 year-to-date in review
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart onboarded over 100 new models from 30 providers in the first three quarters of 2026. This recap covers the model-onboarding highlights and JumpStart enhancements, including the simplified Model Hub, pre-configured deployment options, and Hugging Face deep link integration.
items.creator: Vamsi Goparaju
